recruit_text.backstory: At the traffic lights in Oaxaca, Emiliano breathed fire for coins from car windows, two minutes a red light. He was good at it and very good at talking, and he arrived with a bottle of lamp oil on his belt. The fire here took to him at once. Now it comes out of him the colour of a dragon's breath, and he's cocky about it, and he's earned some of that.
recruit_text.before:
A corner by the zócalo, four younger sisters, and a dream of a circus that would take him on.

In eleven years he didn't burn himself once, and he'll show you his hands to prove it.
recruit_text.forward:
A real show, in a real tent, with an audience that paid to get in.

He's also sending money home on every ship that leaves Cinderwharf, in case one of them finds it.

stages.stranger: Qué onda, carnal, I'm Emiliano, pyromancer and showman. Want to see a trick? I used to do this for coins at a red light, and now I do it for the Ashclaim.
stages.acquaintance: I'm from Oaxaca. I breathed fire at the traffic lights by the zócalo for eleven years, two minutes a red light, coins through the car windows. An old man taught me, who'd worked the same corner for thirty years. You learn to hold a crowd in the time it takes a light to change. Look at my hands, carnal. Eleven years and not one burn.
stages.companion: My father left when I was small, and I was the eldest of five, so at fourteen I was working. My mother, Doña Elvira, sold tamales in the market, and between us we raised my four sisters. I paid for two of them to finish school, and I'm prouder of that than of any trick. I was mid-breath at a red light when the world changed, and I came round in the Ashen Reach with this bottle of lamp oil still on my belt. I send money home on every ship out of Cinderwharf, in case one finds them.
stages.friend: Every year a travelling circus came through Oaxaca, a real one with a tent, and every year I auditioned. Every year they said next year. Now a goblin circus has come to Cinderwharf, and the ringmaster says I can have the main slot if I bring her something nobody's ever seen. I want to breathe a dragon's fire, carnal, the real thing, and I need to see a dragonkin's flame up close. Will you help me?
stages.sworn: I walked out into the ring and breathed a dragon in gold and scarlet, and the whole tent screamed. In the front row there was a woman and four young women, cheering louder than anybody. One of my sisters saw a poster with my name on it in a camp down the coast and dragged the whole family there. My mother said I should have been careful, and I told her I was. I've joined the circus, and they ride in the wagon behind me. Keep the lamp oil. I breathe my own fire now.

moments.prompt: Emiliano is juggling three small flames and grinning at you.

options.reply: Gracias, thank you, thank you! See, that's all I ask for, a little appreciation.
You want me to be careful? Carnal, look at my hands. Eleven years and not a single burn.

moments.prompt: He's asked you to help him study a dragonkin's flame.

options.text: Let's go and steal some fire.
options.reply: Órale, that's the spirit! Stay behind me and look impressed.

options.text: That sounds like a good way to die.
options.reply: Probably, but it's also a good way to get top billing.

lines.bored_warning: Carnal, there's no audience out here, and I'm wasting my best material on rocks.
lines.leaving_good: Great trip, great audience, very chido. I'll be in Cinderwharf by the forges, showing off to anyone who'll watch.
lines.leaving_bored: No crowd, no applause, nothing. I'm going back to Cinderwharf, where people at least watch.
lines.after_wipe: Okay, okay, that trick didn't land. Everybody up, and we do it again with more style.
lines.wipe_warning: We keep bombing in here, carnal, and I hate bombing. After this run I'm taking a few nights off the stage.
lines.wipe_leave: The show's cancelled for a while. I'll be by the forges in Cinderwharf, practising.
lines.zone_warning: Carnal, even I know a crowd I can't win. Everything out here wants us dead, so let's leave.
lines.zone_leave: I'm not dying in front of an audience of monsters. I'll be in Cinderwharf.
lines.gear_refuse: Ey, no, that's part of the act. Ask me after you've clapped a few more times.
lines.gear_taken: Órale, take it. I'll make it look like I meant to lose it.
lines.gear_short: My costume's missing a piece, carnal, and the crowd will notice before you do.
lines.gear_upgrade: Qué chido, that's going to look incredible under a spotlight.
lines.back: I've got a new trick, carnal, and you're going to love it. Where's tonight's stage?
lines.send_word: Emiliano has sent word from Cinderwharf. He's got a new trick and he's ready.
lines.walkout_talk: Walking off stage in the middle of the act is unprofessional, and I did it. Sit down, carnal, and let me explain.
lines.neglect: My favourite audience is back! I saved you a front-row seat.
lines.asked_to_stay: One more show? Carnal, for you, always.
lines.on_break: Emiliano is back in Cinderwharf, by the forges. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.

town_arrive.text: My mother sold tamales in the Oaxaca market, and she could spot a pickpocket from forty stalls away. I learned everything about crowds from her.

boss_down.text: Somebody clap, please, I worked very hard on that one.

close_call.text: Ooh, that one gets a gasp from the crowd, but I'd rather not do it twice.

dungeon_clear.text: Not a single burn on my hands, look. I'll show anyone who asks.
